### 实现长按功能，先打开定时器 ![Pasted image 20250704164515.png](https://github.com/shuai-yemao/Deep-In-Embedded/raw/5fcab575fc20cf681f3e79e163337211097c898a/%E5%B8%B8%E7%94%A8%E9%A9%B1%E5%8A%A8/%E6%98%BE%E7%A4%BA%E5%B1%8F/assets/%E4%B8%B2%E5%8F%A3%E5%B1%8F/Pasted%20image%2020250704164515.png)

### 键盘设置

使键盘初始化为中文输入法和进入退出时清空输入框 ![Pasted image 20250704153527.png](https://github.com/shuai-yemao/Deep-In-Embedded/raw/5fcab575fc20cf681f3e79e163337211097c898a/%E5%B8%B8%E7%94%A8%E9%A9%B1%E5%8A%A8/%E6%98%BE%E7%A4%BA%E5%B1%8F/assets/%E4%B8%B2%E5%8F%A3%E5%B1%8F/Pasted%20image%2020250704153527.png)

![Pasted image 20250704154041.png](https://github.com/shuai-yemao/Deep-In-Embedded/raw/5fcab575fc20cf681f3e79e163337211097c898a/%E5%B8%B8%E7%94%A8%E9%A9%B1%E5%8A%A8/%E6%98%BE%E7%A4%BA%E5%B1%8F/assets/%E4%B8%B2%E5%8F%A3%E5%B1%8F/Pasted%20image%2020250704154041.png)

按钮属性设置为全局，在弹起事件中，第一项是表示当前页面，第二项表示是哪一个控件，最后是跳转到键盘界面

通过串口将键盘输入的数据发送给单片机 ![Pasted image 20250704154700.png](https://github.com/shuai-yemao/Deep-In-Embedded/raw/5fcab575fc20cf681f3e79e163337211097c898a/%E5%B8%B8%E7%94%A8%E9%A9%B1%E5%8A%A8/%E6%98%BE%E7%A4%BA%E5%B1%8F/assets/%E4%B8%B2%E5%8F%A3%E5%B1%8F/Pasted%20image%2020250704154700.png)
